title: lichend persists its identity seed with default world-readable permissions
description: Security review finding: production lichend stores the 32-byte Ed25519 identity seed through generic FileStorage. FileStorage creates directories/files with process umask defaults and never chmods/verifies ownership; a normal umask 022 yields /var/lib/lichen mode 0755 and id.seed mode 0644. Any local user can then recover the gateway private identity, forge link/Schnorr traffic, and derive every state-sealing key. Create the security-state directory as owner-only 0700 and secret files as 0600 using no-follow/exclusive opens, verify owner/mode on every reopen, and fail closed on insecure pre-existing paths. Add Unix permission/ownership tests; public sealed-state files may use separate storage policy.
